summary: Tested the new Licensing fix feature through the API and the UI, plus a regression run. Setup was already done (FM27, 'Sample Club FC'). I wrote a new pytest file, test_fmcc_stage9_licensing.py: 13/13 pass. API results: (1) The scan finds the sample fix file (active, 3 clubs and 1 competition) and the Sample Logo Pack (2 logos). It lists 3 active clubs, 2 of them with a pack logo, and competition 950001 as active. (2) Import: a non-.lnc file gives 422, a .lnc with no name lines gives 422, and the reserved name fmcc_club_names.lnc gives 422. A valid TEST_ file is listed as Imported, and club 900000 shows as unlicensed from that file. (3) Applying works and shows in the Clubs list (rename) and in FMCC's .lnc. Re-applying gives 409. Applying active-in-FM clubs plus competition 950001 gives 409 'Nothing new to apply'. Applying an imported competition and undoing it works, and the status lnc.lines goes up by 2 and back. Undoing a club works; a second undo gives 409 and an unknown kind gives 404. Removing an import works, a second removal gives 404, and path traversal is blocked. (4) Manual club fix: a stadium ID without a name gives 422, a double quote gives 422, founded 1700 gives 422, and an unknown club gives 404; none of these save anything. A valid save writes the CLUB and STADIUM lines and queues 'Year founded' in /changes (founded_queued true). (5) A manual competition fix adds 2 lines to lnc.lines, and a quote gives 422. UI (Playwright, 1920x1080) checks all passed: the editor-tab-licensing cards show the right content. The import button upload shows the toast, then the Imported row, then the checkbox. Apply (1) shows 'Applied', and the Clubs tab shows 'TEST_UI Real Sample Club / was Sample Club FC'. Undo goes back to Unlicensed, and remove deletes the file row. Manual fix: the stadium-without-name toast, the quote error toast, and the success toast 'Fix saved; year founded added to Game changes' all appear, and the form resets. /changes shows 'Kingsmere Town … Year founded → 1901'. The competition fix toast appears. Clubs tab attributes now include 'Year founded (1800–2100)'. Regression: rename, rename remove and the Logo Creator dialog (opened and closed, nothing generated) work, and the Faces tab shows NG status. The stage6-9 regression run gave 54 passed, 6 skipped and 2 failed. Both failures came from the tests, not the app: stage6 test_01 still expected 3 not_editable items, but the app now lists 4 because Nickname was added (I updated the test). Stage7 test_05 depends on test order (it passes on its own; see minor issues). No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: It doesn't check in_save or unlicensed. Applying a club uid from an imported file that isn't in the save (for example 123) returns 200 and writes a CLUB_LONG_NAME_CHANGE for a club that doesn't exist. The UI hides the checkbox for these, but the API accepts them.

It doesn't check name length for names taken from fix files. A 100-character long name from an imported .lnc was applied, but manual fixes and Rename cap long names at 60 and short names at 30. A missing short name falls back to the long name, which can be over 30.

Each club uid is taken from the first file only: active files first, then alphabetical. If an imported file also has a club that is in an active file, its entry is silently hidden, but the file row still counts it ('N clubs').

'applied' only matches when FMCC's rename equals the fix's real name exactly. A club with an active-in-FM fix and a different FMCC/manual rename (978596: 'Manual Real FC' vs the sample's 'Castleford Rovers Football Club') still shows 'Active in FM', with no sign of the conflict. Two .lnc files in FM's folder then rename the same club, and which one wins is undefined.
lnc_present is only computed when renames > 0. If FMCC's .lnc holds only competition or stadium lines, a missing file is never detected, and the banner doesn't mention those lines.

Already there before this change: used_by keeps only one player per NG picture, so when two players use the same picture, which name shows depends on order. This makes stage7 test_05 fail when stage6 runs before it.
Importing a file with the same name silently overwrites the earlier import.

integration_issues.issue: Manual club, stadium and competition fixes aren't listed anywhere on the Licensing tab unless the same uid is in a fix file. You can undo a manual club name from the Clubs tab. A manual stadium fix, or a manual competition with an ID not in any fix file, can't be seen or undone in the UI (only DELETE /api/editor/licensing/stadium|comp/{uid} works).

integration_issues.flow: Manual fix with a double quote
integration_issues.issue: The error toast shows the raw pydantic text "String should match pattern '^[^\x00-\x1f"]+$'" and doesn't name the field. Show a friendly message such as 'Names can't contain double quotes'.

issues: The placeholders are cut off in the half-width inputs: 'Year founded (c', 'Stadium ID (opt'. Shorten them (for example 'Founded', 'Stadium ID') or use labels.
The count badge (4) includes clubs that are already 'Active in FM', so it overstates how many are left to fix. Count only the rows that still need fixing, or relabel the badge.
Plurals are wrong: '1 clubs · 1 competitions · 0 stadiums'.

action_items: Optional: in /licensing/apply, skip clubs that aren't in_save or unlicensed, and trim or validate fix-file names to 60/30 characters
Add a list of the current manual fixes (club name, stadium, competition) with Undo on the Licensing tab, because stadium fixes can't be undone in the UI
Show a friendly validation message for quotes and bad characters instead of the raw regex
Shorten the cut-off placeholders in the manual form; fix the plurals; count only the clubs still to fix in the badge
Optional: flag when an FMCC rename conflicts with an active-in-FM fix for the same club; work out lnc_present from lines, not renames
critical_code_review_comments: manual_club adds the name revision before the 'founded' check. On desktop, if FMLibreEditor can't read the club, it returns 409 or 403 after the name and stadium are already saved. This is documented in the 409 message, but the 403 and other 409 paths come from club_values and don't say so.

remove_import uses resolve() and is_relative_to correctly, and the filename is sanitised. The .lnc regex excludes quotes, so names imported from files can't break FMCC's .lnc. _q() also replaces quotes on write.
scan() regenerates the SAMPLE files only when they're missing, and the sample is guarded by not LIVE. Good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 new); regression 54 passed, 2 failed, both from the tests and not the app (one fixed, one depends on test order)

All TEST_ imports were removed, and applied and manual fixes were undone; branding revisions are append-only, so removal revisions remain for 900000, 998880, 950555, 950777, 950888 and 12399. Main agent data I left alone: fixes/fix.lnc (900000 'Real Sample Club'), the 978596 'Manual Real FC' rename, comps 950001 and 950002, and the queued 978596 'Year founded → 1901'.
